column6: Are torque drivers and flight-test rigs calibrated, labelled and within their due date?
Do operators on each line have current training records for the work instructions they use?
Does every drone have a completed end-of-line flight test record before packing?
Are ESD mats, wrist straps and daily checks in place at every electronics station?
Are PCB lots shipped to Atlas X-ray sampled to the agreed plan, with records kept?
Can each shipped lot be traced to its component lots and build date?
Are process, material or site changes notified to Atlas before shipment?
Are Atlas corrective action requests answered within 30 days?
